name: hcapp_addEditReceipt
description: Creates or updates an HC.Receipt (event expense). Mode is whether @receiptId already exists in HC.Receipt: found → UPDATE (COALESCE partial), else INSERT with a server NEWID() when @receiptId is NULL / zero UUID. Sentinels normalised before auth (lines 68-76): @removed -1 → NULL (keep), negative amounts → NULL, zero-UUID @reimbursedBy → NULL, blank strings → NULL, @imageUrl shorter than 20 → NULL. @reimbursedBy = FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF clears all four reimbursement fields; any other non-NULL @reimbursedBy sets ReimbursedOn = GETDATE() and copies the receipt's stored ReceiptAmount into ReimbursedAmount. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 43, standard token). @eventId required → 1243. Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageReceipts' for the event's kennel, the designated hare of THIS event allowed → else 1343 (errorType 13). After COMMIT delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for @eventId with only the receipts watermark live. Every parameter is positional-required: none has a SQL default (see codeSmells).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for token validation.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic auth token. Validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth (SP number 43). Auth failure returns errorType=11.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: Receipt to update. NULL or the zero UUID → insert mode with a server NEWID(); a UUID not found in HC.Receipt also inserts (with that id). NO SQL DEFAULT: the client must pass it, NULL or not.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Required. NULL or null-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode=1243, errorType=12). Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: receiptShortDesc
parameters.description: Short description of the expense. Empty string normalised to NULL. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern). Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is NVARCHAR(500); table column is NVARCHAR(255). Values between 256 and 500 chars will be silently truncated by SQL Server on insert/update.

parameters.name: receiptAmount
parameters.description: Amount of the expense. Negative values normalised to NULL before auth. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern). Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional free-text notes on the expense. Empty string normalised to NULL. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: reimbursedBy
parameters.description: Hasher who reimbursed. Zero UUID → NULL (keep existing). FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF = clear-reimbursement sentinel (nulls ReimbursedBy/On/Amount/Notes). Any other UUID auto-sets ReimbursedOn = GETDATE() and ReimbursedAmount = the stored ReceiptAmount. No SQL default.

parameters.name: reimbursedOn
parameters.description: Reimbursement timestamp (typed DATETIMEOFFSET(7), no string CAST as in HC5). Values before 2000-01-01 → NULL. Overridden to GETDATE() when @reimbursedBy is a real hasher. No SQL default.

parameters.name: reimbursedAmount
parameters.description: Amount reimbursed. Negative → NULL. Overridden from Receipt.ReceiptAmount when @reimbursedBy is a real hasher. On UPDATE NULL keeps the existing value. No SQL default.

parameters.name: reimbursedNotes
parameters.description: Notes on the reimbursement. Blank → NULL (keep on UPDATE). No SQL default.

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.description: URL of the receipt image. LEN < 20 → NULL (keep on UPDATE). No SQL default.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is NVARCHAR(1000); table column is NVARCHAR(500). URLs between 501 and 1000 chars will be silently truncated by SQL Server on insert/update.

parameters.name: receiptsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData; NULL → 'ignore'. All other watermarks are hardcoded 'ignore'. No SQL default.

parameters.name: removed
parameters.description: Soft-delete flag. -1 → NULL (keep existing); 1 = removed; on INSERT written as given (NULL if -1 — see codeSmells). No SQL default.

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as the first rowset. success=1 on success; success=0 on auth failure, validation failure, or unhandled DB error. errorCode and errorType are NULL on success.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1243 null/empty eventId (errorType 12); 1343 not authorised (13); 1943 unhandled (19); ValidateAppAuth 1143 invalid token (1) / 1343 device not registered (3) / 1243 signed out (7) — note 1243 and 1343 each serve two conditions.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1/3/7 auth; 12 validation; 13 not authorised; 19 unhandled.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on any failure path (auth, validation, or unhandled DB error). Not present on success — rowset 1 on success is the first rowset from hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for this error instance.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error type code matching the WriteEnvelope errorType.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code matching the WriteEnvelope errorCode.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: On success, rowsets 1+ are the full output of HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData (multiple rowsets). See that SP's contract for column definitions. The receipts rowset is refreshed using the caller-supplied @receiptsUpdatedAfter watermark; all other watermarks are 'ignore'.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Receipt — when @receiptId is non-null and found in HC.Receipt (within transaction)
INSERT HC.Receipt — when @receiptId is null, null-UUID, or not found in HC.Receipt (within transaction)
EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageReceipts' (@isHareOfEvent from HasherEventMap.IsHare) — pre-flight, outside the transaction
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on 1243, 1343 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK)
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — delegation after commit, outside TRY block; returns multiple rowsets for event admin data refresh

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @reimbursedOn. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: @imageUrl parameter width exceeds table column width
codeSmells.detail: @imageUrl is NVARCHAR(1000) but HC.Receipt.ImageUrl is NVARCHAR(500). Any URL longer than 500 characters will be silently truncated on INSERT or UPDATE by SQL Server (or raise a string-truncation error depending on ANSI_WARNINGS setting).

codeSmells.issue: @receiptShortDesc parameter width exceeds table column width
codeSmells.detail: @receiptShortDesc is NVARCHAR(500) but HC.Receipt.ReceiptShortDesc is NVARCHAR(255). Values between 256 and 500 chars will be silently truncated or raise a truncation error.

The all-F UUID (line 145) is a magic sentinel value used to trigger clearing of all reimbursement fields. This is an unusual and undocumented-in-parameters convention that callers must know about. Carried forward from HC5. Consider replacing with an explicit @clearReimbursement BIT parameter in a future version.

codeSmells.issue: Negative sentinel values for numeric parameters
codeSmells.detail: Lines 69, 71: negative @reimbursedAmount and negative @receiptAmount are normalised to NULL as a sentinel for 'no value'. This is an implicit contract that callers must know — negative expense amounts are not representable. Consider using nullable parameters instead.

codeSmells.issue: Sync delegation runs outside the transaction and outside TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 214-230: EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData is called after COMMIT and outside the TRY block. If the delegation fails, the receipt write has already committed and the caller receives no sync data — but also no error envelope. The error from the inner SP propagates directly to the caller as a raw SQL error, bypassing the HC6 error envelope pattern.

Line 68: @removed = -1 is normalised to NULL (keep existing). The HC6 pattern prefers nullable parameters over sentinel magic values. Low severity because this is consistent with HC5 behaviour and the mobile caller is already built around it.

Line 189: CostCategory is always inserted as 0. There is no @costCategory parameter, so callers cannot categorise an expense at creation time. If category management is ever needed, this will require a breaking change.

codeSmells.issue: INSERT can violate NOT NULL on ReceiptAmount / removed
codeSmells.detail: Lines 183-192: a negative @receiptAmount is normalised to NULL (line 71) and @removed = -1 to NULL (line 68), but Receipt.ReceiptAmount and Receipt.removed are NOT NULL. On INSERT those become constraint violations caught as 1943 'Unexpected error' rather than a validation message.

breakingChanges: @reimbursedOn type changed from NVARCHAR(50) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers that previously sent a date string must now send a typed DATETIMEOFFSET value
TRY/CATCH and transaction wrapping added — HC5 had neither; error behaviour on insert/update failure is now consistent and enrolled in the HC6 error envelope
DATALENGTH replaced with LEN for @imageUrl length guard — functionally equivalent for NVARCHAR; no caller impact
Success envelope rowset (WriteEnvelope) added as rowset 0 — HC5 had no success envelope; callers must consume rowset 0 before the syncEventAdminData rowsets
Delegation updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData
